description.title: System admin login successfully
description.step:
- Navigate to login page
- Enter system admin email
- Enter system admin password
- Click login button
- Verify redirect to /system dashboard
description.expected:
- Login succeeds without company selection
- Redirected to /system (System Dashboard)
- Dashboard header visible
- Sidebar shows 'System Admin' label

description.title: System admin login with wrong password
description.step:
- Navigate to login page
- Enter system admin email
- Enter wrong password
- Click login button
description.expected:
- Login fails
- Error message displayed
- Stay on login page

description.title: System dashboard shows stat cards
description.step:
- Login as system admin
- Navigate to /system
- Verify all 4 stat cards are visible
description.expected:
- Companies card visible with count
- Users card visible with count
- Devices card visible with count
- Last 7 Days card visible

description.title: Navigate to company list from dashboard
description.step:
- Login as system admin
- Click 'Companies' in sidebar
- Verify company list page loads
description.expected:
- URL changes to /system/companies
- Company list table visible
